articles.summary: Stewart Information Services Corporation ( NYSE:STC ) today announced that Michael Brown has been appointed to its Board of Directors. "We are extremely pleased to welcome Michael Brown to our Board of Directors," said Chief Executive Officer Fred Eppinger. "Mr. Brown's extensive experience in finance, banking and insurance, along with a proven track record of leadership and success at the executive level, will further strengthen our Board and provide valuable insight as we execute our strategy, capitalize on opportunities for growth and continue delivering long-term value for our customers, shareholders and colleagues." "Mr. Brown brings a valuable combination of executive leadership, public company board service and deep financial services expertise to Stewart," said Tom Apel, Chairman of the Stewart Board.
